evidence_limit: Original Gross and Mackay report that honeybees remove previously deposited stigma pollen and do not collect from anthers; fruit and seed effects cannot be treated as anther-source removal
Original Diaz and Kitzberger report parakeet destructive harvest of wind-pollinated flowers and pollen emptying; pollen-specific male-fitness loss is not isolated from total flower destruction

Original Lundgren Razzak and Wiedenmann document predators containing maize pollen and pollen deposition in a cornfield; plant pollen export and reproductive fitness loss from this insect consumption are not measured
